name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.PolyB.mul
typeText:
∀ {f g : Nat → Nat},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.PolyB f →
    DisequalityDispersion.Machine.PolyB g → DisequalityDispersion.Machine.PolyB fun n => HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (f n) (g n)

source.code:
theorem PolyB.mul {f g : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : PolyB f) (hg : PolyB g) : PolyB (fun n => f n * g n) := by
  obtain ⟨C₁, c₁, hC₁, h₁⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨C₂, c₂, hC₂, h₂⟩ := hg
  refine ⟨C₁ * C₂, c₁ + c₂, Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity), fun n => ?_⟩
  calc f n * g n ≤ (C₁ * (n + 1) ^ c₁) * (C₂ * (n + 1) ^ c₂) := Nat.mul_le_mul (h₁ n) (h₂ n)
    _ = C₁ * C₂ * (n + 1) ^ (c₁ + c₂) := by ring
